gloss_en: The subduing of the 'luminaries of fire' (me'orei eish, נִכְנָעִין מְאוֹרֵי אֵשׁ) — the state/process in which the fiery luminaries (the destructive forces by which the Temple was burned, the 'ashes' of Isaiah 61:3) are brought low through mourning over the Temple/Zion, allowing the luminaries of light (Shabbat) to prevail; refers to the act of their subjugation, not to the luminaries-of-fire entity itself
